zh-CN.title: 前台通话
items: 通话支持全屏与折叠，聊天中保留适配各个气泡主题的通话记录。
私聊的更多操作与可配置快捷操作均可发起通话。
拨打菜单仅保留通话和取消，统一图标与横幅按钮样式。
VIP 双方各有每周五分钟额度，拨打前检查双方可用时长。

en.title: Foreground calls
items: Calls support full-screen and minimized views, with call records matching each chat bubble theme.
Start calls from direct-chat More actions or configurable chat shortcuts.
The menu offers only Call and Cancel, with consistent call icons and banner controls.
Both VIP participants receive five minutes per week, checked before dialing.
